+def authenticate_predecessor(
+    repo: Path,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], list[dict[str, Any]], tuple[dict[str, Any], ...]]:
+    manifest_path = repo / OUTPUT_RELATIVE / PREDECESSOR_SNAPSHOT_NAME
+    require(manifest_path.is_file(), "P1 predecessor manifest missing")
+    require(
+        sha256_file(manifest_path) == PREDECESSOR_MANIFEST_SHA256,
+        "P1 predecessor snapshot bytes drift",
+    )
+    manifest = read_json(manifest_path)
+    require(
+        manifest.get("issue") == PREDECESSOR_ISSUE
+        and manifest.get("active_paper_scope") == "9709:paper:p1",
+        "P1 predecessor manifest identity drift",
+    )
+    candidate_records = [
+        *manifest.get("input_artifacts", []),
+        *manifest.get("family_deltas", []),
+        *manifest.get("output_artifacts", []),
+    ]
+    require(
+        len(candidate_records) == 19,
+        "predecessor manifest must expose all 19 raw-byte receipts",
+    )
+    generated = P1.build_release(repo)
+    generated_names = (
+        "series-semantic-delta.json",
+        "p1-terminal-dispositions.json",
+        "p1-cumulative-projection.json",
+        "product-readback.json",
+        "active-p1-release-manifest.json",
+    )
+    generated_by_name = dict(zip(generated_names, generated, strict=True))
+    predecessor_output_names = set(generated_names[:-1])
+    authenticated = []
+    authenticated_by_path: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    for record in candidate_records:
+        prior = authenticated_by_path.get(record["path"])
+        require(
+            prior is None
+            or all(
+                prior[key] == record[key]
+                for key in ("path", "sha256", "byte_length")
+            ),
+            f"conflicting predecessor receipts: {record['path']}",
+        )
+        relative = Path(record["path"])
+        path = repo / relative
+        if relative.name in predecessor_output_names:
+            encoded = canonical_bytes(generated_by_name[relative.name])
+            require(
+                len(encoded) == record["byte_length"]
+                and sha256_bytes(encoded) == record["sha256"],
+                f"reconstructed predecessor byte failed: {relative}",
+            )
+        else:
+            require(path.is_file(), f"predecessor byte missing: {relative}")
+            require(
+                path.stat().st_size == record["byte_length"]
+                and sha256_file(path) == record["sha256"],
+                f"predecessor byte authentication failed: {relative}",
+            )
+        authenticated.append(deepcopy(record))
+        if relative.name not in predecessor_output_names:
+            authenticated_by_path[record["path"]] = deepcopy(record)
+    for name in generated_names[:-1]:
+        expected = next(
+            item for item in manifest["output_artifacts"]
+            if Path(item["path"]).name == name
+        )
+        require(
+            sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(generated_by_name[name]))
+            == expected["sha256"],
+            f"deterministic predecessor reconstruction drift: {name}",
+        )
+    require(
+        sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(generated_by_name[MANIFEST_NAME]))
+        == PREDECESSOR_MANIFEST_SHA256,
+        "deterministic predecessor manifest reconstruction drift",
+    )
+    return manifest, list(authenticated_by_path.values()), generated

+    source_map = read_json(repo / SOURCE_MAP_RELATIVE)

+    verified = {
+        item["node_id"]
+        for item in nodes_document["nodes"]
+        if item.get("node_type") == "Question"
+    }
+    rows = []
+    excluded = []
+    for row in source_map["rows"]:

+                row["question_row_id"]
+            ),

+        )
+    rows.sort(key=lambda item: item["question_key"])

+        and len(rows) + len(excluded) == EXPECTED_DISCOVERABLE_QUESTIONS,
+        "P1 Functions discoverable/verified scope drift",

+    require(

+        "P1 Functions source text join is incomplete",

+                    or code == ABSTAIN_CODE

+    excluded = []

+                row["question_row_id"]
+            ),

+            current
+        )
+    rows.sort(key=lambda item: item["question_key"])
+    require(
+        len(rows) == EXPECTED_REVIEWED_QUESTIONS
+        and len(rows) + len(excluded) == EXPECTED_DISCOVERABLE_QUESTIONS,
+        "P1 Functions discoverable/verified scope drift",
+    )
+    require(
+        len({item["question_key"] for item in rows}) == len(rows),
+        "canonical Functions source identities collide",

+            "reviewed_series_score_owning_part_count"
+        ],
+        "reviewed_trigonometry_question_count": predecessor["summary"][
+            "reviewed_trigonometry_question_count"
+        ],
+        "reviewed_trigonometry_score_owning_part_count": predecessor[
+            "summary"
+        ]["reviewed_trigonometry_score_owning_part_count"],
+        "reviewed_differentiation_question_count": predecessor["summary"][
+            "reviewed_differentiation_question_count"
+        ],
+        "reviewed_differentiation_score_owning_part_count": predecessor[
+            "summary"
+        ]["reviewed_differentiation_score_owning_part_count"],
+        "reviewed_integration_question_count": predecessor["summary"][
+            "reviewed_integration_question_count"
+        ],
+        "reviewed_integration_score_owning_part_count": predecessor["summary"][
+            "reviewed_integration_score_owning_part_count"
+        ],
+        "score_owning_question_part_count": EXPECTED_P1_SCORE_PARTS,
+    }
+    return terminal
+

+def edge(
+    source: str, edge_type: str, target: str, status: str
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return P1.edge(source, edge_type, target, status)

+def build_projection(
+    predecessor: dict[str, Any],
+    delta: dict[str, Any],
+    base_nodes_document: dict[str, Any],
+    base_edges_document: dict[str, Any],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    projection = deepcopy(predecessor)
+    projection["issue"] = ISSUE
+    nodes = {item["node_id"]: item for item in projection["nodes"]}
+    edges = {item["edge_id"]: item for item in projection["edges"]}
+    base_nodes = {item["node_id"] for item in base_nodes_document["nodes"]}
+    base_edges = {item["edge_id"] for item in base_edges_document["edges"]}
+
+    def add_node(node: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+        require(
+            node["node_id"] not in nodes and node["node_id"] not in base_nodes,
+            f"duplicate projected node: {node['node_id']}",
+        )
+        nodes[node["node_id"]] = node
+
+    def add_edge(current: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+        require(
+            current["edge_id"] not in edges
+            and current["edge_id"] not in base_edges,
+            f"duplicate projected edge: {current['edge_id']}",
+        )
+        edges[current["edge_id"]] = current
+
+    add_node(
+        {
+            "label": "Functions",
+            "node_id": FAMILY_ID,
+            "node_type": "QuestionFamily",
+            "status": "approved",
+        }
+    )
+    for question_type in P1_TYPE_DEFINITIONS:
+        type_id = question_type["question_type_id"]
+        add_node(
+            {
+                **deepcopy(question_type),
+                "node_id": type_id,
+                "node_type": "QuestionType",
+            }
+        )
+        add_edge(edge(FAMILY_ID, "CONTAINS", type_id, "approved"))
+
+    model_by_id = {
+        item["procedure_model_id"]: item for item in P1_PROCEDURES
+    }
+    for model_id, source_model in model_by_id.items():
+        model = deepcopy(source_model)
+        model["representative_question_refs"] = [
+            {
+                "question_id": item["question_id"],
+                "question_part_id": item["question_part_id"],
+            }
+            for item in delta["procedure_instances"]
+            if item["status"] == "approved"
+            and item["procedure_model_ref"] == model_id
+        ][:3]
+        add_node(
+            {
+                **model,
+                "node_id": model_id,
+                "node_type": "ProcedureModel",
+            }
+        )
+        add_edge(
+            edge(
+                model["question_type_id"],
+                "USES_PROCEDURE",
+                model_id,
+                "approved",
+            )
+        )
+        for step in model["procedure_steps"]:
+            step_id = step["procedure_step_id"]
+            add_node(
+                {
+                    **deepcopy(step),
+                    "node_id": step_id,
+                    "node_type": "ProcedureStep",
+                    "procedure_model_id": model_id,
+                }
+            )
+            add_edge(edge(model_id, "HAS_STEP", step_id, "approved"))
+
+    for record in delta["question_records"]:
+        for binding in record["classification_bindings"]:
+            current = edge(
+                binding["question_part_id"],
+                "PART_CLASSIFIED_AS",
+                binding["question_type_id"],
+                "approved",
+            )
+            current["classification_origin"] = (
+                "issue_1748_reviewed_p1_question_part"
+            )
+            current["classification_role"] = binding["classification_role"]
+            current["part_ownership_decision_ref"] = binding["decision_id"]
+            add_edge(current)
+
+    projected_instances = [
+        item
+        for item in delta["procedure_instances"]
+        if item["status"] == "approved"
+        or item.get("projection_status") == "admitted_candidate"
+    ]
+    for instance in projected_instances:
+        instance_id = instance["procedure_instance_id"]
+        add_node(
+            {
+                **deepcopy(instance),
+                "node_id": instance_id,
+                "node_type": "ProcedureInstance",
+            }
+        )
+        add_edge(
+            edge(
+                instance["question_part_id"],
+                "HAS_PROCEDURE_INSTANCE",
+                instance_id,
+                instance["status"],
+            )
+        )
+        add_edge(
+            edge(
+                instance_id,
+                "INSTANCE_OF",
+                instance["procedure_model_ref"],
+                instance["status"],
+            )
+        )
+        for anchor_id in [
+            *instance["qp_evidence_anchor_refs"],
+            *instance["ms_evidence_anchor_refs"],
+        ]:
+            add_edge(
+                edge(
+                    instance_id,
+                    "SUPPORTED_BY",
+                    anchor_id,
+                    instance["status"],
+                )
+            )
+
+    projection["nodes"] = sorted(
+        nodes.values(), key=lambda item: item["node_id"]
+    )
+    projection["edges"] = sorted(
+        edges.values(), key=lambda item: item["edge_id"]
+    )
+    projection["summary"] = {
+        "approved_part_classification_edge_count": sum(
+            item["edge_type"] == "PART_CLASSIFIED_AS"
+            and item["status"] == "approved"
+            for item in projection["edges"]
+        ),
+        "approved_procedure_instance_count": sum(
+            item["node_type"] == "ProcedureInstance"
+            and item["status"] == "approved"
+            for item in projection["nodes"]
+        ),
+        "candidate_part_classification_edge_count": sum(
+            item["edge_type"] == "PART_CLASSIFIED_AS"
+            and item["status"] == "candidate"
+            for item in projection["edges"]
+        ),
+        "candidate_procedure_instance_count": sum(
+            item["node_type"] == "ProcedureInstance"
+            and item["status"] == "candidate"
+            for item in projection["nodes"]
+        ),
+        "overlay_edge_count": len(projection["edges"]),
+        "overlay_node_count": len(projection["nodes"]),
+        "semantic_library_node_count": sum(
+            item["node_type"]
+            in {"QuestionType", "ProcedureModel", "ProcedureStep"}
+            for item in projection["nodes"]
+        ),
+        "structural_node_copy_count": 0,
+    }
+    return projection
+
+
+def validate_release(
+    predecessor_projection: dict[str, Any],
+    predecessor_terminal: dict[str, Any],
+    delta: dict[str, Any],
+    terminal: dict[str, Any],
+    projection: dict[str, Any],
+    base_nodes_document: dict[str, Any],
+    base_edges_document: dict[str, Any],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    require(
+        len(terminal["question_dispositions"]) == EXPECTED_P1_QUESTIONS
+        and len(terminal["question_part_dispositions"]) == EXPECTED_P1_PARTS,
+        "P1 terminal inventory count drift",
+    )
+    require(
+        len(delta["decisions"]) == EXPECTED_REVIEWED_SCORE_PARTS
+        and len(
+            {item["question_part_id"] for item in delta["decisions"]}
+        )
+        == EXPECTED_REVIEWED_SCORE_PARTS,
+        "reviewed QuestionPart conservation failed",
+    )
+    require(
+        all(
+            item["review_status"] == "reviewed_terminal"
+            and item["exact_part_evidence_refs"]["qp_evidence_anchor_refs"]
+            and item["exact_part_evidence_refs"]["ms_evidence_anchor_refs"]
+            for item in delta["decisions"]
+        ),
+        "reviewed score-owning part lacks exact evidence",
+    )
+    require(
+        delta["excluded_unverified_question_refs"] == [],
+        "verified Functions scope unexpectedly excluded a source row",
+    )
+    fail_closed = {
+        item["question_part_id"]
+        for item in delta["decisions"]
+        if item["disposition"] == "abstain_no_functions_demand"
+    }
+    require(
+        fail_closed == {"qrow_9709_w20_qp_13_q06::q06/b"},
+        "incidental symbolic rewrite did not remain fail-closed",
+    )
+    selected_ids = set(delta["question_statuses"])
+    predecessor_question_entries = {
+        item["question_id"]: item
+        for item in predecessor_terminal["question_dispositions"]
+    }
+    current_question_entries = {
+        item["question_id"]: item for item in terminal["question_dispositions"]
+    }
+    require(
+        all(
+            current_question_entries[key] == value
+            for key, value in predecessor_question_entries.items()
+            if key not in selected_ids
+        ),
+        "prior P1 question terminal disposition changed",
+    )
+    selected_part_ids = {
+        item["question_part_id"] for item in delta["decisions"]
+    }
+    predecessor_part_entries = {
+        item["question_part_id"]: item
+        for item in predecessor_terminal["question_part_dispositions"]
+    }
+    current_part_entries = {
+        item["question_part_id"]: item
+        for item in terminal["question_part_dispositions"]
+    }
+    require(
+        all(
+            current_part_entries[key] == value
+            for key, value in predecessor_part_entries.items()
+            if key not in selected_part_ids
+            and value["question_id"] not in selected_ids
+        ),
+        "prior P1 QuestionPart terminal disposition changed",
+    )
+
+    predecessor_nodes = {
+        item["node_id"]: item for item in predecessor_projection["nodes"]
+    }
+    current_nodes = {item["node_id"]: item for item in projection["nodes"]}
+    predecessor_edges = {
+        item["edge_id"]: item for item in predecessor_projection["edges"]
+    }
+    current_edges = {item["edge_id"]: item for item in projection["edges"]}
+    require(
+        all(current_nodes[key] == value for key, value in predecessor_nodes.items())
+        and all(current_edges[key] == value for key, value in predecessor_edges.items()),
+        "predecessor cumulative projection changed",
+    )
+    classifications_by_part: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    for item in projection["edges"]:
+        if (
+            item["edge_type"] == "PART_CLASSIFIED_AS"
+            and item["status"] == "approved"
+        ):
+            classifications_by_part[item["from_node_id"]].append(item)
+    require(
+        all(
+            sum(
+                item.get("classification_role") == "primary"
+                for item in classifications
+            )
+            == 1
+            for classifications in classifications_by_part.values()
+        ),
+        "cross-Family primary QuestionPart ownership conflict",
+    )
+    base_node_ids = {item["node_id"] for item in base_nodes_document["nodes"]}
+    overlay_node_ids = set(current_nodes)
+    require(
+        base_node_ids.isdisjoint(overlay_node_ids),
+        "compact overlay copied or duplicated a structural/global node",
+    )
+    all_nodes = base_node_ids | overlay_node_ids
+    require(
+        all(
+            item["from_node_id"] in all_nodes
+            and item["to_node_id"] in all_nodes
+            for item in projection["edges"]
+        ),
+        "cumulative projection contains a dangling edge",
+    )
+    base_edge_ids = {item["edge_id"] for item in base_edges_document["edges"]}
+    require(
+        base_edge_ids.isdisjoint(current_edges),
+        "compact overlay duplicated a global edge",
+    )
+    approved_instances = [
+        item
+        for item in delta["procedure_instances"]
+        if item["status"] == "approved"
+    ]
+    require(
+        all(
+            item["qp_evidence_anchor_refs"]
+            and item["ms_evidence_anchor_refs"]
+            for item in delta["procedure_instances"]
+        ),
+        "ProcedureInstance candidate or approved object lacks exact part evidence",
+    )
+    instances_by_branch: dict[tuple[str, str], list[dict[str, Any]]] = (
+        defaultdict(list)
+    )
+    for item in delta["procedure_instances"]:
+        instances_by_branch[
+            (item["question_part_id"], item["branch_key"])
+        ].append(item)
+    require(
+        all(
+            sorted(item["sequence_index"] for item in items)
+            == list(range(1, len(items) + 1))
+            for items in instances_by_branch.values()
+        ),
+        "ProcedureInstance branch sequence is not contiguous",
+    )
+    require(
+        {
+            (item["question_part_id"], item["branch_key"])
+            for item in approved_instances
+            if item["branch_key"] == "branch:alternative"
+        }
+        == set(),
+        "unsupported alternative branch was introduced",
+    )
+    candidate_ids = {
+        item["procedure_instance_id"]
+        for item in delta["projected_candidate_procedure_instances"]
+    }
+    require(
+        all(
+            current_nodes[item]["status"] == "candidate"
+            for item in candidate_ids
+        )
+        and not any(
+            edge_item["status"] == "approved"
+            and (
+                edge_item["from_node_id"] in candidate_ids
+                or edge_item["to_node_id"] in candidate_ids
+            )
+            for edge_item in projection["edges"]
+        ),
+        "candidate ProcedureInstance crossed the approved boundary",
+    )
+    new_model_ids = {
+        item["procedure_model_id"] for item in P1_PROCEDURES
+    }
+    p3_library = read_json(REPO / P3_RELATIVE / "procedure-library.json")
